CHECK ((((evenement)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['RECHERCHE_VIDE'::character varying, 'FICHE_OUVERTE'::character varying, 'AJOUT_PANIER'::character varying, 'FRAIS_VUS'::character varying, 'SORTIE_APRES_FRAIS'::character varying, 'REACHAT_AJOUTE'::character varying, 'WHATSAPP_OUVERT'::character varying])::text[])) AND ((langue)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['fr'::character varying, 'en'::character varying])::text[])) AND ((appareil)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['mobile'::character varying, 'tablette'::character varying, 'ordinateur'::character varying])::text[])) AND ((reception)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['GENERAL'::character varying, 'RETRAIT'::character varying, 'LIVRAISON_A_CONFIRMER'::character varying, 'LIVRAISON_CALCULEE'::character varying])::text[])) AND
CASE
    WHEN ((evenement)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['FRAIS_VUS'::character varying, 'SORTIE_APRES_FRAIS'::character varying])::text[])) THEN ((reception)::text <> 'GENERAL'::text)
    ELSE ((reception)::text = 'GENERAL'::text)
END AND (nombre > 0)))

CASE
    WHEN ((evenement)::text = ANY (ARRAY[('FRAIS_VUS'::character varying)::text, ('SORTIE_APRES_FRAIS'::character varying)::text])) THEN ((reception)::text <> 'GENERAL'::text)
    ELSE ((reception)::text = 'GENERAL'::text)
END AND (nombre > 0)))
